facts.value: An application without a completed bachelor's degree is possible if at least 80% of the required credits in the bachelor's program have been completed at the time of application.

Proof of enrollment in the bachelor's program and a preliminary transcript that includes an average grade and all previous examination performances must be submitted if the bachelor's degree has not yet been completed.
May 15
Maximum ECTS for bachelor's: 180 ECTS, Minimum ECTS for application: 144 ECTS
Maximum ECTS for bachelor's: 210 ECTS, Minimum ECTS for application: 168 ECTS
Maximum ECTS for bachelor's: 240 ECTS, Minimum ECTS for application: 192 ECTS
The bachelor's degree transcript must be submitted by the end of the first semester of the master's program to obtain final admission.
If your degree is from a university outside Germany, an online application through the Uni Assist portal is sufficient.
For applications to a higher semester, besides the required application documents, a request for recognition and a performance overview of completed credits must be submitted.
Applications must be submitted by January 15 or May 15.
Credits not listed on the performance record can be recognized if a request for transfer is submitted with the application.

The program is restricted in admission for all semesters. Applications for the summer semester are possible for the second or fourth semester; for the winter semester, applications are possible for the third semester.
Application deadline January 15 for classification into the 2nd or 4th semester.
Application deadline May 15 for classification into the 3rd semester.
Enrollment in a higher semester can only occur if open study places are available and the corresponding number of ECTS credits for recognition is provided.
Up to 30 ECTS results in classification into the 2nd semester.
31 to 60 ECTS results in classification into the 3rd semester.
61 to 90 ECTS results in classification into the 4th semester.
If open study places are available and more applications for the higher semester are received, a ranking is created according to the valid selection regulations.
Summer semester application: Submitted ECTS: 3 courses of 6 ECTS, Transfer-relevant ECTS: 18, Classification: 2nd semester.

Summer semester application: Submitted ECTS: 9 courses of 6 ECTS, Transfer-relevant ECTS: 54, Classification: No classification possible as transfer-relevant credits allow only classification into the 3rd semester, which is not possible for the summer semester.
Summer semester application: Submitted ECTS: 5 courses of 6 ECTS, Transfer-relevant ECTS: 30, Classification: 2nd semester.
Winter semester application: Submitted ECTS: 11 courses of 6 ECTS, Transfer-relevant ECTS: 66, Classification: Classification not possible.
For further information on recognition regulations, refer to § 29 of the current examination regulations.
